tool_args.rationale: The highest pilot gradient, 2.44, reaches the gray zone but stays below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost measurement that directly tests whether the smooth response gives way to an avalanche loss.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot is consistent with this model but cannot establish that it remains valid above the proposed threshold.
All pilot gradients are below the proposed onset, so the threshold and avalanche strength cannot be estimated from these rows.
It costs more and does not directly target the sink-gradient boundary.
